scenarios.title: Open/Close Connection
scenarios.description: Open a connection to an app service that generates a random number between a minimum and maximum value, generate the number, then close (dispose) the AppServiceConnection.

controls.name: GenerateRandomNumber
controls.expected: opens connection, requests random number, displays it in Result, closes connection

outputs.name: Result
outputs.expected: shows generated random number or error

scenarios.title: Keep Connection Open
scenarios.description: Open a long-lived AppServiceConnection, generate random numbers reusing the same connection, and close the connection explicitly.

controls.name: OpenConnection
controls.expected: opens and keeps the AppServiceConnection open

controls.name: GenerateRandomNumber
controls.expected: requests random number over the open connection and displays it in Result

outputs.name: Result
outputs.expected: shows generated random number or error
